newsitem.title: USA: American Mobile stake raised by investor.
newsitem.headline: American Mobile stake raised by investor.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Tuesday he raised his stake in American Mobile Satellite Corp to the equivalent of 4,976,733 common shares, or 16.6 percent of the total outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said he bought, through firms he controls, 522,000 additional shares of American Mobile between December 3 and January 1 at prices ranging from $11.875 to $13.625 a share.
Baron said the stake includes warrants to purchase 625,000 shares. He and his companies previously held a 14.8 percent stake, or 4,454,733 common shares in American Mobile.
Based in Reston, Va., American Mobile operates North America's first high-powered, satellite-based mobile communications systems.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, BAMCO Inc and Baron Capital Inc, all based in New York.
